sources.title: qwen-turbo model information
sources.evidence: Search-indexed official page identifies the Qwen3 alias with qwen-turbo-2025-04-28; 131072-token context, text input/output, optional thinking, and no Function Calling in Beijing or Singapore. Direct opening now redirects to the general models page, so these are the last documented specifications rather than a live service test.

sources.title: Qwen Key Concepts
sources.evidence: Identifies Qwen as an Alibaba Group model family and explicitly lists Qwen Turbo among proprietary language models, separately from open-weight checkpoints.

sources.title: Qwen2.5: A Party of Foundation Models!
sources.evidence: September 19, 2024 announcement already offers Qwen-Turbo through Model Studio APIs. Published sizes and dense architecture in this post apply to its separately listed open-weight models.

sources.title: Extending the Context Length to 1M Tokens!
sources.evidence: November 15, 2024 announcement gives the older Qwen2.5-Turbo revision a 1M-token context and sparse attention; it does not establish specifications of the later Qwen3 alias.

sources.title: Notice on the Decommissioning of Certain Historical Mainline Models
sources.evidence: Official notice schedules qwen-turbo decommissioning in Beijing and Singapore for October 10, 2026; inference calls cease after decommissioning. No API execution was performed during this audit.

sources.title: Output price of Qwen-Plus and Qwen-Turbo reduced under Qwen3 thinking mode
sources.evidence: July 14, 2025 announcement explicitly lists thinking-mode pricing for Qwen-Turbo and Qwen-Turbo-2025-04-28, effective July 18.

developer.note: Qwen Team is part of Alibaba Group.

family.note: Broad family retained; this hosted alias later used Qwen3.

release_date.note: Initial alias launch date unresolved. Qwen-Turbo existed by September 19, 2024, before the baseline November 1 date. April 28, 2025 identifies the later revision rather than the alias launch.

open_weights.note: Explicitly proprietary; do not substitute an open Qwen checkpoint.

license.note: No open-weight license applies to this proprietary API model; service terms are separate.

parameters_b.note: Exact total parameter count is not published; the comparison with QwQ-32B is not a count.

active_parameters_b.note: No exact active parameter count is published.

architecture.note: No exact dense/MoE topology is established for the final alias. Open Qwen checkpoint architectures and older sparse-attention details cannot be transferred.

context_window.note: Tokens; corrects the older revision limit.

reasoning.note: Optional thinking mode is explicitly documented.

tool_call.note: Function Calling is explicitly unsupported in both documented regions.

description.value: Proprietary Qwen3 text model with thinking and non-thinking modes; the final qwen-turbo alias matched the 2025-04-28 snapshot.
description.note: Replaces broad workload claims with documented model identity and modes.

patch.description: Proprietary Qwen3 text model with thinking and non-thinking modes; the final qwen-turbo alias matched the 2025-04-28 snapshot.
patch.notes: Hosted alias, not an open checkpoint. Exact total/active parameter counts and dense/MoE architecture are undisclosed. Original alias release date remains unresolved. Alibaba scheduled retirement in Beijing and Singapore for 2026-10-10; endpoint availability was not tested.

summary: Correct context from 1M to 131072 and tool calling to false for the final documented Qwen3 alias. Clear unsupported initial release date and replace generic description. Preserve unknown parameter counts and architecture; the proprietary endpoint is distinct from open checkpoints. Official retirement was scheduled for October 10, 2026. Model-info evidence was accessible in the search index, while its current direct URL redirects.
